item.title: Tomodachi Life: Living The Dream's Price And Box Art Have Been Revealed
item.description: Dream scenario.After a particularly packed Nintendo Direct, we've got our first glimpse at the official Switch box art for Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream (yes, it's very cute) and the all-important price.Let's kick things off with the price tag, eh? The game is now available to pre-order from the UK, European and North American eShops for £49.99 / 59,99€ / $59.99, which is roughly what we'd expect for a first-party Switch 1 release.
